# .dockerignore Explainer: what does docker build send, and which line excludes each file?

> Free .dockerignore checker. From a .dockerignore, a file list and optionally a Dockerfile, it says which paths BuildKit sends in the build context and the line that decides each one, flags COPY/ADD and RUN --mount=type=bind sources the rules exclude (the cause of "not found" COPY errors), .env files, private keys, credentials files, .git and node_modules still sent, patterns that only match at the context root (`*.log` is not `**/*.log` in Docker), `!folder` exceptions that re-include nothing (write `!folder/**`), `[!a]` classes (Go negates with `^`), indented `#` lines that are patterns, and syntax errors that fail every build. It writes a fixed .dockerignore and re-runs it against the list before offering it. Runs in the browser; nothing is uploaded. A zero-dependency CLI runs it over a real context folder.

Free and open source (MIT). The engine is a line-by-line port of moby/patternmatcher v0.6.1 (ignorefile.ReadAll, MatchesUsingParentResults) and tonistiigi/fsutil's filtered walk, the code BuildKit (Docker Engine 23+, docker buildx) runs; it is replayed against that Go code on 5,000 random trees in every test run. It models BuildKit, not the legacy builder. Not legal, security or professional advice; your own docker build is the final word.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://marisstella.app/dockerignore-explainer/)
- [Why a .dockerignore pattern does not match in subfolders](https://marisstella.app/dockerignore-explainer/why-dockerignore-pattern-does-not-match-subfolders.html)

## For agents

- Engine: `dockerignore.mjs`. `analyze({ ignore, files, dockerfile })`: `ignore` is the .dockerignore text; `files` is newline-separated paths (`find . -type f` or `git ls-files` output; `size path` lines from `find . -type f -printf '%s %p\n'` add sizes; a trailing `/` marks an empty folder) or an array of paths; `dockerfile` is optional Dockerfile text. Returns `rows` (per path: `sent`, deciding `rule` {line, text}, `via` the folder where the deciding line matched, `unvisited` the skipped folder above it), `findings` (id, severity, line, title, detail, paths), `fix` (`text`, `replaced`, `appended`, `fixed`, `unfixed`, `sideEffects`), `totals` and `biggest`. `why({ ignore, path })` gives the folder-by-folder steps. `matcher.mjs` `resolve(ignoreText, buildTree(files))` is the bare BuildKit port. `DEFAULTS` is the page's example. Callable through `node platform/agents/tools.mjs call dockerignore-explainer analyze --input '{"ignore":"*.log","files":"a.log\nlogs/b.log"}'` or the repository's MCP server (`call_tool`).
- CLI: `node ventures/dockerignore-explainer/cli/check.mjs <context-dir>` (`-f Dockerfile`, `--why <path>`, `--fixed`, `--json`, `--strict`). Reads `<Dockerfile>.dockerignore` before `.dockerignore`, as BuildKit does.
